title: LPC to LSF/LSP Conversion
text: 将线性预测系数转换为线谱对或线谱频率，输入 1 路、输出 4 路、无直接馈通；按 {If first input value is not 1} 指定第一个输入值不为 1 时采取的操作；{Output} 指定转换输出 LSP in range、{Root finding coarse grid points} 指定搜索步数、{Root finding bisection refinement} 指定二分次数、{Show output validity status} 显示输出有效性状态、{If current output is invalid, overwrite with previous output} 指定用前一输出覆盖无效输出、{When first output is invalid, overwrite with user-defined values} 指定用用户定义的值覆盖无效的第一个输出、{User-defined LSP/LSF values for overwriting invalid first output} 指定用户定义的 LSP/LSF 值，按实例取值。

ports.name: A
ports.summary: 线性预测系数 column vector | unoriented vector | matrix

ports.name: LSP
ports.summary: 线谱对 column vector | unoriented vector | matrix

ports.name: LSFn
ports.summary: 归一化到范围 (0 0.5) 内的线谱频率 column vector | unoriented vector | matrix

ports.name: LSFr
ports.summary: 范围 (0 π) 内的线谱频率 column vector | unoriented vector | matrix

ports.name: Status
ports.summary: 输出的有效性状态 scalar | row vector

params.name: Output
params.values: 转换输出 LSP in range (-1 1) (default) | LSF normalized in range (0 0.5) | LSF in range (0 pi)

params.name: Root finding coarse grid points
params.values: 搜索步数 64 (default) | positive integer greater than 1

params.name: Show output validity status
params.values: 显示输出有效性状态 off (default) | on

params.name: If current output is invalid, overwrite with previous output
params.values: 用前一输出覆盖无效输出 off (default) | on

params.name: When first output is invalid, overwrite with user-defined values
params.values: 用用户定义的值覆盖无效的第一个输出 off (default) | on

params.name: User-defined LSP/LSF values for overwriting invalid first output
params.values: 用户定义的 LSP/LSF 值 vector (default) | matrix

params.name: If first input value is not 1
params.values: 第一个输入值不为 1 时采取的操作 Ignore (default) | Normalize | Normalize and warn | Error
